content.text: In Tanzania, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-every-detail-you-2|COREMERCH guide to digital]] creators face a critical barrier: global payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal are either unavailable or severely restricted. This leaves you unable to sell your digital products—ebooks, courses, templates—to a global audience. But what if you could own your commerce [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-digital-product-stores-kyc-payments|The Full]]? What if you could accept payments directly, without intermediaries? This guide shows you how to deploy a sovereign commerce stack using blockchain-based payments and Cloudflare infrastructure. No platform dependencies. No geographic restrictions. Full ownership. You’ll learn to set up a system that works anywhere, for anyone, using tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/nowpayments-integration-static-site-crypto-payments-first-principles|nowpayments]]. By the end, you’ll have a fully operational online store that processes crypto payments automatically, delivers products instantly, and keeps your data secure. This isn’t a workaround—it’s base-layer infrastructure built to last.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Selling Digital Products from Africa: The Complete Infrastructure Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-africa-step-step-deployment-guide. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Global payment platforms fail creators in Tanzania for two reasons: geographic restrictions and centralized control. Stripe and PayPal decide who can use their services, and Tanzania is often excluded. Even when available, these platforms can freeze accounts or withhold funds without warning. This infrastructure solves both problems. First, it uses blockchain-based payments via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies and requires no KYC. Buyers pay directly from their wallets, and you receive funds on-chain. Second, it leverages decentralized hosting and storage. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your store for free. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets store orders. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers files. No single point of failure. No platform can shut you down. This architecture is sovereign—you own every component. It’s built to withstand the same pressures that led to its creation in Zimbabwe, where currency collapse and financial isolation demanded a better solution.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying, gather three things: a domain name, a crypto wallet, and your digital products. First, buy a domain name from any registrar—Namecheap or Porkbun are affordable options. This will be your store’s address. Second, set up a crypto wallet that supports BSC, Solana, or TRON for low-fee transactions. MetaMask or Trust Wallet work well. This is where you’ll receive payments. Third, organize your digital products into a folder. Each product should be a single file—PDF, ZIP, or video. Name files clearly, e.g., "Ebook_Guide_to_Photography.pdf." Once these are ready, choose your stack. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) is ideal for beginners, while the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers advanced features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration. If you prefer to build yourself, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all blueprints and templates. Ensure your internet connection is stable—deployment requires uploading files and configuring APIs. With these tools in hand, you’re ready to build.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by configuring your payment gateway. Sign up for NOWPayments and create a payment link for each product. Select BSC, Solana, or TRON for low fees. NOWPayments will generate a webhook URL that triggers when payment confirms on-chain. Next, set up your backend logic. If using GitHub Pages + Apps Script (Sovereign Starter Stack), deploy the provided script to handle payment verification and file delivery. For Cloudflare Pages + Workers (Edge Commerce Stack), configure a Worker to listen for NOWPayments webhooks and serve files from Cloudflare R2. Test the pipeline by sending a test payment. Use a small amount of crypto to ensure the webhook fires and the file downloads correctly. If using Supabase, verify that order data is logged accurately. This pipeline is the core of your infrastructure. Once live, it runs automatically—no manual intervention required.
Own your commerce infrastructure—no platform dependencies.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Deploy your store by uploading files to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Connect your domain name to the deployment. Test all links to ensure products load correctly. Share your store with your audience. When a buyer purchases a product, NOWPayments will verify the payment on-chain and fire the webhook. Your backend logic will deliver the file instantly. Monitor your first transactions closely. Check your crypto wallet to confirm funds are received. Verify that buyers receive their downloads without issues. If using Supabase, review order data to ensure accuracy. This is your moment of infrastructure sovereignty. No platform took a cut. No intermediary delayed delivery. You’re now operating a global commerce stack from Tanzania—on your terms.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your stack live, focus on scaling. Add more products by uploading files and creating new NOWPayments links. Update your backend logic to handle additional SKUs. Optimize for performance by compressing large files and using CDN caching. Monitor transaction fees—switch networks if costs rise. For example, if BSC fees increase, shift to Solana or TRON. Expand your reach by translating your store into multiple languages. Use Cloudflare’s geo-targeting to serve localized content. Track analytics with Google Sheets or Supabase to identify top-selling products. Reinvest profits into marketing or new product development. This infrastructure is designed to grow with you. It’s not a temporary fix—it’s a permanent solution. As you scale, you’ll never outgrow the stack. You own it. You control it. It’s yours.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

To accept crypto payments in Tanzania without Stripe or PayPal, deploy a sovereign commerce stack using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain payment verification. Store orders in Supabase or Google Sheets and deliver files via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This infrastructure eliminates geographic restrictions and platform dependencies, giving you full control over your online store.
Accept 300+ cryptocurrencies with automatic on-chain verification.

Ready to deploy your own sovereign commerce stack? The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all blueprints, templates, and guides needed to build and scale your infrastructure. From payment processing to file delivery, every component is designed for maximum ownership and minimal fees. Start today at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Gather a domain name, crypto wallet, and digital products. 2. Choose your stack: Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197). 3. Sign up for NOWPayments and configure payment links for each product. 4. Deploy backend logic using GitHub Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. 5. Upload files to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages and connect your domain. 6. Test the payment and delivery pipeline with a small transaction. 7. Monitor your first live transactions and verify wallet receipts. 8. Scale by adding products, optimizing performance, and expanding your audience.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this infrastructure if I’m not technical?
Yes. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) is designed for non-technical users. It includes pre-configured scripts and 30-day support to guide you through deployment.
What cryptocurrencies can buyers use to pay?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON, with transactions under $0.10.
Do I need to pay monthly fees for this infrastructure?
No. This is a one-time purchase. You own the infrastructure after deployment. The only fee is NOWPayments’ 0.5% transaction charge.
Can I sell physical products with this stack?
This stack is designed for digital products. For physical goods, you’ll need to integrate shipping logic, which is not included in the current blueprints.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
NOWPayments operates on blockchain, which has no single point of failure. However, you can add redundancy by integrating a second payment gateway if desired.
